title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Claims Desk: Reversing a Below-Deductible Roof Surfacing Denial
content:
**HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, claims desk: roof surfacing damage denied below the deductible.**

## When this policy applies

This policy re-settles the wind or hail roof surfacing damage of the most recently reported claim on a HomeGuard policy when that damage stands on the claim only as a below-deductible denial entry. It fixes the amount of the payment that replaces the denial. The claim is identified by the latest first-notice entry on the policy.

## What the payment records

The reversal is booked as one new **roof surfacing payment entry** on the dwelling coverage part of that claim. The entry replaces the below-deductible denial entry of the roof surfacing. It carries the replacement-cost value and depreciation of the denial it replaces, the roof age, the deductible the roof surfacing absorbs, the amount paid and the payee. The claim's paid total rises by the amount, and the insured sees a new roof payment on the claim file dated the day it is issued.

## Kind of payment and payee

| Situation on the declarations and the claim | Kind of payment |
|---|---|
| The declarations carry the roof surfacing schedule | Roof schedule payment |
| The covered amount is the full replacement-cost value | Full replacement-cost payment |
| Any other case | Actual-cash-value initial payment, with the recorded depreciation withheld |

The payee follows the claim settlement payee rule of the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy.

## Tool: `settle_denied_roof_surfacing_b6cb399f`

**Capability.** Issues the claim payment that replaces a below-deductible denial of roof surfacing damage on a HomeGuard homeowners claim. One call records one new roof surfacing payment on the dwelling coverage part of the named claim. When the payment kind is an actual-cash-value initial payment, the recorded depreciation is also withheld on the claim as recoverable depreciation in the same call. The tool records the figures it is given; it does not work them out.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `settle_denied_roof_surfacing_b6cb399f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `home_policy_id` | Reference number of the HomeGuard policy the claim is made under, as returned by the home policy lookup for the verified customer | Id |
| `claim_number` | The claim number exactly as it appears on the claim's first-notice entry returned by the claim lookup | Verbatim, character for character |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the below-deductible denial entry of the roof surfacing that this payment replaces, as returned by the claim lookup | Id |
| `payment_type` | The kind of roof payment | Enum: `roof_schedule` (paid on the roof payment schedule percentage), `replacement_cost_full` (paid at full replacement-cost value, nothing withheld), `acv_initial` (paid at actual cash value, depreciation withheld for later recovery) |
| `roof_age_years` | Roof age at the date of loss | Integer years, no decimals |
| `deductible_applied` | Part of the occurrence deductible absorbed by this payment | USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when none |
| `amount` | Amount paid on this roof surfacing payment | USD, 2 decimal places, positive |
| `payee` | Who the payment is made out to | Enum: `insured` (the named insured alone), `insured_and_mortgagee` (the mortgagee on file named as co-payee with the insured) |

**Return.** On success the tool returns: `status` "recorded"; `payment_entry_id`, the reference number of the new roof payment entry; `claim_number`; `payment_type` as recorded; `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `deductible_applied` (USD, 2 decimal places); `payee`; `holdback_entry_id`, the reference number of the recoverable depreciation withheld, or empty when nothing was withheld; and `entry_date`, the payment date (YYYY-MM-DD).

**Illustrative call shape (hypothetical values).** `payment_type` `acv_initial` with a positive recorded depreciation on the replaced denial returns a non-empty `holdback_entry_id`. The same call with `roof_schedule` returns an empty one.
